lines.text: Could you guess what stopped 15 Nazi Panzer divisions 200 miles before D-Day failed?
In 1944, the Allies created a completely fake military force: the First US Army Group, commanded by General George Patton.
Across the coast of Dover, soldiers inflated dummy rubber tanks, parked wooden aircraft, and broadcasted ghost radio chatter.
German reconnaissance fell for the trap. Hitler became convinced the real invasion would land at Pas-de-Calais, holding his best tanks 200 miles away.
By the time Berlin realized Normandy was the real assault, it was too late. An army of rubber balloons saved the Western world.
